line: Every day is a good day. Even a day that surprises you.
Maybe you'll eat, maybe you'll fast. Guruji said: each morning, wake up and practise.
credit: Pattabhi Jois · recalled by David Williams

line: So train on the calm days, and you stay steady when hard ones come.
credit: Seneca · Letters to Lucilius 18, tr. Gummere

line: Why? Pain that has not come yet is pain you can still avoid.
Wally Funk said her body and mind were ready. At 82, she reached space.
Astronauts practise things going wrong, again and again. So when it happens, no panic.
Japan has a word for it: heijoshin, the everyday mind that stays steady.
Keep planting seeds, morning and evening. You never know which one will grow.
A day's plan lies in its morning. A life's plan lies in steady effort.
One Ashtanga student said: practice makes me better at facing life's challenges.
